recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a self-contained browser-native interactive visual novel called **Rite of the Rent-Controlled Room**. Preserve the original mechanics: mobile start button, typed dialogue, tap-to-complete/tap-to-advance, three stacked choices that apply numeric score deltas to a 50-point starting score, a dynamic four-ending threshold check at 75/40/10, and restart/menu buttons. Reinterpret the score as **Grace** inside a satirical possession-horror exorcism. Use a portrait-first layout, large touch targets, Creepster/Cinzel typography, dark approved catalog audio, and procedural canvas art showing a cramped bedroom, levitating vessel, sacred cross/seal motifs, candle motes, and oppressive horror ambience. Do not add combat, timers, inventory, physics, or new progression rules.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Mobile-first interactive visual novel / story choice game.
- objective: Advance dialogue, choose responses, and maintain enough relationship score to reach a favorable ending.
- input model: Tap/click start, tap dialogue to finish or advance typewriter text, tap one of three stacked choices, tap restart/menu on ending screen.
- core loop: Start screen -> typed story node -> tap advance -> choice node -> score mutation -> more dialogue -> dynamic ending check -> one of four endings.
- fail/friction state: Low score produces colder/bad endings; no death or physics failure exists.

## Protected mechanics
- Single canonical HTML surface with canvas ambience and DOM UI.
- Typewriter dialogue pacing and tap-to-complete behavior.
- Three-choice branching nodes with numeric score deltas.
- Score starts at 50 and maps to four endings with thresholds 75, 40, and 10.
- Restart returns to the same language and resets score; menu returns to start.
- Pointer/click bindings must remain mobile-safe without global touch suppression.

## Remixed target
Rite of the Rent-Controlled Room preserves the visual-novel choice mechanics but reframes the score as Grace in a satirical possession-horror bedside exorcism. The focal identity is a levitating possessed vessel in a claustrophobic room; choices are ritual responses balancing faith, skepticism, and comedy. The authored presentation uses procedural canvas furniture, candles, sacred seal motifs, dark catalog audio, Creepster/Cinzel typography, and portrait-first UI.
